evidence_boundaries: Only branch_id or explicit .branch_id/@branch_id parameter valueStr equality names the corresponding branch configuration.
136 branches/147 direct field references are configuration references; actual callback/trigger/frame remainunknown.
Three published device rules are applied only to exact original IDs, integer instance/skill level1 and fixed PHASE_0 declarations; other IDs/levels remainunknown.
Model terminal/midpoint docs never automatically apply to _a/_b cloned IDs, even if labels or prefab resemblance match.
Nine ACTIVATE_PREDEFINED actions map to unique explicit alias objects; no routeIndex or IDsuffix position inference.
SPAWN branch positions/routes stayNone; stages/phase catalog is reused without duplicate query wrappers or changingenemy inheritance.

trap_219_fttreant.trigger_reference: 攻击范围内出现我方干员时，按关卡配置召唤树盾或树墙，使召出敌人生命比例对应自身，随后强制击杀自身。

source.read_method: 本次搜索结果正文包含完整机制与精确trap_086_larva模型路径；直接页打开失败，不声称页脚版本固定

trap_086_larva.trigger_reference: 装置被摧毁，或者关卡内所有预配置敌方单位被击倒时，在自身位置尝试按预设路径召出食腐使徒；若未先被摧毁，召出后撤退自身。

trap_323_shsbox.trigger_reference: 受击后尝试按预设路径召出恶笼草；成功召出后装置无原因退场。装置与召出敌人为不同目标。
